2 سلّحهُ He armed him with a weapon or weapons. (A.) And سلّحهُ السَّيْفَ, (K, TA,) and القَوْسَ, (TA,) He armed him with the sword, (K, TA,) and the bow. (TA.) ＝
-A2- سلّح الإِبِلَ, (A, TA,) inf. n. تَسِْيحٌ, (TA,) It caused the camels to void سُلَاح [or thin excrement; i. e. it purged them]; said of a herb. (A, TA.) [See also 4.] ＝
-A3- سلّح نِحْيَهُ, inf. n. as above, He rubbed over his نِحْى [or skin for holding clarified butter] with سُلْح, i. e. rob, or inspissated juice. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
